---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for a new feature or enhancement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

## Feature Category

Select which component this feature affects:
- [ ] Backend (Flask API)
- [ ] Frontend (HTML/CSS/JavaScript)
- [ ] Database
- [ ] AI Recommendation Engine
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] CI/CD
- [ ] Other (please specify)

## Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you're requesting. What problem does it solve? What use case does it address?

## Use Case

Describe the use case or scenario where this feature would be useful.

Example:
- As a [user type], I want to [action] so that [benefit]

## Proposed Solution

If you have an idea for how this feature should work or be implemented, describe it here.

## Alternative Solutions

Describe any alternative solutions or approaches you've considered.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, examples, or references (links to similar features, external tools, etc.) that might be helpful.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Feature is implemented
- [ ] Unit tests are added
- [ ] Documentation is updated
- [ ] No regressions in existing functionality
